budget.budget_method: Retain registered full work and inclusive budgets. Measure per-update durations from the parent 72-row metrics; do not extrapolate only from wall averages or reduce requested budget.

measured_completed_72_update_durations_s.interpretation: First interval includes entry evaluation and setup; values are recorded elapsed deltas, not isolated optimizer time.

continuation.episode_initial_indices: Exact parent next_episode_indices; no episode-zero restart or replacement master seed.
continuation.evaluations: Same 64 D2 development seeds; deterministic argmax; entry and final only.
continuation.ppo: Unchanged parent PPO; K=4, batch=64, rollout=256, full teacher 128/2/4.

gates: Only exact successful normal schema, complete update 72, exact parent receipt, candidate hash, and parent registration hash authorize continuation.
Reject failed, interrupted, cancelled, missing receipt, mismatched hash, or mid-update parent.
No historic D1, failed D2, diagnostic, or old checkpoint validator changes.
No exact trajectory resume claim: environment state was not saved; preserve 64 parent abandoned-live-episode records and provenance.
Candidate remains training_eligible=false pending independent parent acceptance.
scope: Prepare one normal D2 continuation only; no training, environment rollouts, or evaluation.
